Work with Me

✅ 1-to-1 Writing Feedback
https://www.writerscience.com/work-with-me/

How to Write Engaging Science Writing: 4 Storytelling Principles from Siddhartha Mukherjee
Want to write about complex topics without boring your readers? In this video, I break down four storytelling techniques the best science writers use to make dense material feel like a page-turner — analyzed through Siddhartha Mukherjee's New Yorker writing. Whether you're writing a science article, a nonfiction book, a research-based essay, or a Substack newsletter, these principles will help you turn information into narrative. No dumbing down required.
